text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy grounds, 
I came across Phalaenopsis 
deep in conversation with Grass Wonder 
and No Reason.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Indeed. It stands to reason that 
naginata and nagamaki 
were prized on the battlefield for so 
long.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, while cleaning out the Miho 
Dorm storeroom, 
an old practice naginata was uncovered.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And so, we were having a lively discussion 
on the martial arts. 
When fellow practitioners gather, the 
conversation simply never ends.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Like—when swinging a blade, 
are you the type to let the sword lead 
your body? 
Or let your body lead the sword? That 
kinda stuff!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Do you attune yourself to the blade's 
weight and let your body 
move in harmony with its swing? Or do you 
make bodily movement 
the master, treating the blade as 
subservient? That is the question.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, as expected of Lady Phalaeno. 
A lucid and straightforward explanation 
indeed.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
As for me, I favor the "body comes first" 
doctrine. On the battlefield, 
any weapon is expendable. I see the 
endless adaptability of the body 
as the true key to surviving deadly peril.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—I am fond of the philosophy that "the 
sword comes first." 
For instance, I am sure you are all 
familiar with the secret 
of the "Single Strike" passed down in 
Kashima.
choice_data_list: (...Are we really supposed to know that?)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Please imagine it. 
That you are standing upon a battlefield 
at this very moment.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
On the threshold of life and death, 
superficial techniques are meaningless. 
Therefore, abandoning all ego—and 
entrusting everything to 
a single strike—must surely be the true 
essence of martial arts.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That is the "Single Strike." 
Whether with a sword, a naginata, or even 
running, it is a 
philosophy applicable anywhere, and one I 
hold very dear.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I see. Applicable to any battle, you say? 
Fascinating—yet it feels a pity to leave 
it only as words.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Would you care to spar with me, if you are 
willing? 
We have the proper weapons at hand, after 
all. 
I should like to witness the brilliance of 
your "Single Strike," Grass.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho! If that be the case, how about no 
rules? 
Both Lady Phalaeno and Lady Grass are well 
versed 
in the martial arts. You will find it 
freer that way.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I will not forget that this is 
merely sparring. 
...Please, grant me a match.

—Facing one another, each gripping a 
naginata. 
Several minutes had already passed amid 
the quiet, yet suffocatingly tense 
atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: EEEIYAAAHHH!!!!

In an instant, Grass Wonder unleashed a 
piercing kiai 
and swept toward her shins—Phalaenopsis 
swiftly leapt 
backward, the blade just slicing through 
empty air.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho. Reading Lady Phalaeno's intent to 
strike, 
Lady Grass preempted her. A magnificent 
display of "sen-no-sen"!
choice_data_list:
Aren't they taking this way too seriously 
after all...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Have no fear. Neither has lost herself in 
the fray. 
More importantly, keep thine eyes peeled! 
'Twould be a terrible waste to miss such a 
glorious duel!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(—I see. I know not which style she 
mastered, 
but there is certainly the spirit of 
Kashima in her blade. 
I would rather not take that head-on... 
Now then.)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In my soul, there lingers neither delusion 
nor cowardice. 
—Come!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: SEEEIYAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —! She vanished?! Where did—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Got you!!

At the moment they crossed paths, 
Phalaenopsis released 
her naginata and leaped—slipping behind 
Grass Wonder 
to seize the back of her collar! This was—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nay! Lady Phalaeno is not the only one 
versed in the gentle arts!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: EIHHH!!!!

The moment Grass Wonder shifted her body 
to counter, 
Phalaenopsis, still gripping her collar, 
flew through the air— 
somersaulting mid-flight to land lightly 
on her feet.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... A magnificent aiki throw. 
It seems you took this round cleanly from 
me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —No. I am the one who lost this bout.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Please look at what has fallen on the 
ground there. 
When you leapt just now, Phalaeno-san, 
you threw it at my torso and struck true.
choice_data_list: Is this... an ice cream spoon?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oh—from the ice cream I was eating 
earlier! 
And here I was wondering where it had 
vanished after I finished!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In real combat, that would equate to a 
shuriken. 
My Single Strike was dodged as well, 
so I clearly still have much to learn.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No, in the end, I had no choice but to 
rely on trickery. 
It is I who am lacking in discipline.
choice_data_list:
The intensity and speed of that clash was 
incredible.

A tournament to decide the strongest in 
martial arts sounds fun too...

A tournament to decide the strongest in 
martial arts sounds like fun...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No, in the end, I had no choice but to 
rely on trickery. 
It is I who am lacking in discipline.
choice_data_list:
The intensity and speed of that clash was 
incredible.

A tournament to decide the strongest in 
martial arts sounds fun too...

A tournament to decide the strongest in 
martial arts sounds like fun...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It was truly an enjoyable match. 
—If the opportunity arises again, I would 
be honored.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Fufu. The pleasure was mine.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hold on a moment! We have yet to 
decide 
who is the strongest here! 
Next, I shall show you the arts my father 
drilled into me!

And so, their "play"—which felt no 
different 
from a duel to the death—continued on.
